text:
deploy-bot: Started rollout: release v2.20.3 -> prod (canary 5%). Post-deploy smoke and heartbeat probes enabled.
monitor-bot: ALERT probe-kv-prefill eu-central p99_latency increased to 980ms (baseline 120ms) at 2026-03-21T16:00:12Z. fail_rate=1.6%
Alex: saw the monitor alert. Is this impacting real traffic? any 5xx or user complaints?
Priya: prod client 5xx steady at 0.03%. No user reports. This looks probe-only so far.
dave: digging into probe logs now, looks like a cluster of timeouts originating from particular host pools in eu-central.
ops-bot: synthetic-probe: kv-prefill sampler=500ms window=10m run=kp-20260321-01 anomalies=7 p99=980ms
Alex: could be correlated with our nightly maintenance window? isn't there a DB compaction job that runs on a 5m cadence?
Priya: yes, the db-compact job runs every 5m with a short lock spike. We recently moved timing to be aligned with top-of-minute; probes use top-of-minute seeds -> risk of sync.
dave: hypothesis: probe seeds are aligning with db compaction, causing transient connection contention. Proposal: add jitter to probe seed and temporarily reduce canary weight to 1% until we confirm.
lina: +1 on jitter. Also consider pinning the kv-prefill route to the last stable model variant for canary traffic until this settles. That reduces risk if there is any degrade.
Alex: operational plan: 1) set probe_seed_jitter=0-3s; 2) set sampler_ms=250 temporarily; 3) reduce canary to 1%; 4) pin kv-prefill route for canary to v2.20.2. If client 5xx increases above 0.5% or probe_fail_rate>5% for 5m -> rollback.
Priya: I'm pushing the gating patch to canary controller and synth config:
```
/patch canary-config {
  canary_weight: 1
  annotate: "temp-canary-1pct-2026-03-21"
}
/patch synth-kv-prefill {
  sampler_ms: 250
  probe_seed_jitter_sec: 3
  annotate: "temp-jitter-20260321"
}
```
ops-bot: Patches applied. canary weight set to 1% (deploybot run id db-20260321-01). synth resample running.
monitor-bot: Quick-check T+3m: probe_kv_prefill fail_rate decreased to 0.8%, p99_latency=210ms. client 5xx unchanged.
dave: tracing correlation between probe timestamps and db-compact starts shows strong overlap previously; after jitter the overlap disappears. Looks like root cause identified.
Alex: good signal. Lina, please apply the pin:
```
/pin route kv-prefill -> variant v2.20.2 canary_only true reason="mitigate probe alignment"
```
lina: pin applied pin_id=pin-20260321-kvpf-2.20.2.
Priya: recommending we resume canary ramp to 5% in 10 minutes if no regressions. I'll monitor for 15m after ramp.
Alex: agreed. Also create follow-up ticket to avoid long-term probe top-of-minute seeds and to check DB compaction timing.
dave: created ticket INF-4750: "Investigate probe seeding and db compaction alignment; consider probe jitter default". assign: dave, priya.
monitor-bot: Post-change T+10m: p99_latency stable 130ms, fail_rate=0.4%. client 5xx stable.
Alex: rolling canary back to 5% now.
ops-bot: Canary weight updated to 5%.
Priya: monitoring closely for 20m. if any degradation -> hold and escalate.
Alex: add a release note line: "Mitigated postdeploy kv-prefill probe spikes by adding probe jitter and temporary canary pin; no customer impact". Lina please add.
lina: added release note to CHANGELOG and release ticket.
Alex: final decision: no rollback, incident mitigated, follow-up INF-4750 for root cause. closing watch in 30m if stable. :white_check_mark:
monitor-bot: Closing note: canary stable, no rollback required.
Priya: thanks team, keeping channel open but will close thread in 30m unless alerts fire.
